items.question: What is Simplified Startup?
items.answer: We're a digital marketing agency that helps businesses grow online — SEO, ads, social media, websites, AI automation, and more. The whole idea is simple: show prices openly, do great work, and skip the sales games.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: We're based in the Raleigh–Cary area of North Carolina, and we work with clients across the country.

items.question: What size businesses do you work with?
items.answer: Mostly small and mid-sized businesses — from brand-new startups to established local companies with several locations. If your business fits somewhere in that range, we can help.

items.question: What industries do you work with?
items.answer: A wide range: realtors, lawyers, therapists, dentists, doctors, restaurants, salons, gyms, home services, e-commerce, and more. We have dedicated pages for each industry we support.

items.question: What makes you different from other agencies?
items.answer: Two things. First, our prices are shown publicly — no “book a call to hear our rates.” Second, we lead with AI and automation, so we can do more work faster without cutting quality.

items.question: What services do you offer?
items.answer: Pretty much every marketing service: SEO, Google Ads, social media, website design, branding, email marketing, lead generation, AI automation, and more. See the full list on the Services page.

items.question: Can I buy just one service, or do I have to pick a package?
items.answer: Both work. You can buy any service on its own, pick a bundle (a few related services grouped together), or choose a full package for a bundle discount.

items.question: Do you offer accounting or bookkeeping?
items.answer: Not yet — it's listed as “coming soon” and we'll launch it once we have the right team in place.

items.question: Do you build websites?
items.answer: Yes. We build fast, mobile-friendly websites, single landing pages, and full e-commerce stores. Website design is one of our core services.

items.question: Can you handle just my Google Business Profile or reviews?
items.answer: Yes — individual services like Google Business Profile setup and review management can be booked on their own.

items.question: Do you do AI-related work?
items.answer: Yes, and it's a focus for us. AI automation, chatbots, workflow automation, and getting your business mentioned inside AI tools like ChatGPT are all services we offer.

items.question: Where can I see your prices?
items.answer: On every service page and on our main Pricing page. Every service and package has a clear price — no hidden fees, no gotcha upsells.

items.question: Why do you show your prices publicly when most agencies don't?
items.answer: Because we think it's the right thing to do. It respects your time, and it means the people who reach out already know what things cost — so conversations get straight to the point.

items.question: Do you charge monthly or one-time?
items.answer: Both. Some services (like SEO or social media management) are monthly; others (like a logo or a one-time website build) are one-time. The pricing on each service page makes it clear.

items.question: Do bundles or packages save money?
items.answer: Yes — packages come with roughly a 20% discount compared to buying each service on its own.

items.question: How do I get started with Simplified Startup?
items.answer: Book a free strategy call through our Contact page. We'll talk about your goals, recommend the right service or package, and answer any questions before you commit to anything.

items.question: Is the first call really free?
items.answer: Yes — no charge, no pressure, no obligation. It's a real conversation to see if we're a good fit.

items.question: What do I need to prepare before we start?
items.answer: Not much. We'll send a short intake form covering your business, goals, existing accounts, and brand assets. We handle the rest.

items.question: Do I need to already have a website?
items.answer: No. If you don't have one, we can build it. If you do, we can work with it and improve it.

items.question: How long until I see results?
items.answer: It depends on the service. Paid ads and social media can produce results within days or weeks. SEO and content take longer — usually 3–6 months to see meaningful movement. We tell you what to expect up front.

items.question: Will I be assigned a dedicated point of contact?
items.answer: Yes. You'll have a main point of contact who handles your account and coordinates the specialists working on it.

items.question: How often will we communicate?
items.answer: For most clients: weekly or biweekly check-ins by email or short call, plus a monthly report. We're flexible — tell us what works.

items.question: How do you report on results?
items.answer: You get a plain-language monthly report showing what we did, what changed, and what's next — no dashboard full of jargon you'd need a translator for.

items.question: Do you use AI in your work?
items.answer: Yes — we use AI to speed up research, first drafts, and repetitive tasks. Our marketing team then reviews, edits, and finalizes everything. AI helps us go faster, not lower quality.

items.question: Can I request changes to my strategy?
items.answer: Absolutely. Your strategy is a plan, not a contract carved in stone. If something needs to change, we adjust.

items.question: What is SEO?
items.answer: Search Engine Optimization — the work that helps your website show up higher in Google's free (unpaid) search results.

items.question: How long does SEO take?
items.answer: Usually 3–6 months to see meaningful movement, and 6–12 months for stronger results. Anyone promising rankings in 30 days is not being honest with you.

items.question: What's the difference between SEO and Google Ads?
items.answer: SEO is free traffic from Google, but it takes time to build. Google Ads are paid — you show up immediately, but you stop showing up when the budget runs out. Most businesses do both.

items.question: Do I need to be on every social media platform?
items.answer: No. Being on the right two or three platforms consistently beats being on all of them halfheartedly.

items.question: What is a “money page”?
items.answer: A page built around one specific service, business type, and location — like “SEO for realtors in Raleigh.” It's designed to rank for very specific searches with strong buying intent.

items.question: What is AI search / GEO?
items.answer: “GEO” is Generative Engine Optimization — the work of getting your business mentioned when someone asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Perplexity for recommendations. It matters more every year.

items.question: Do I have to sign a long-term contract?
items.answer: No long lock-in contracts. Most services are month-to-month.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes. We ask for a short notice period (usually 30 days) so we can wrap things up cleanly.

items.question: What happens if I pause services and want to come back?
items.answer: You can. We keep your account details on file, and starting up again is quick.

items.question: What happens to my website, content, and social accounts if we part ways?
items.answer: They're yours. We build everything under your ownership, and you keep full access to all your accounts.

items.question: I'm an existing client and need help — what's the fastest way to reach you?
items.answer: Email your account contact directly, or reply to your most recent thread. For urgent things, call the number we shared during onboarding.

items.question: Can I add a new service to my existing account?
items.answer: Yes — just let your account contact know what you'd like to add and we'll set it up.

items.question: How do I get access to my reports?
items.answer: Reports are emailed monthly. If you need one resent, just ask.

items.question: Who owns the content and assets you create for me?
items.answer: You do. Everything we create for your business — content, designs, ad accounts, social accounts — belongs to you.

items.question: What data do you collect?
items.answer: The information needed to do the work: contact info, business details, account access, and marketing performance data. We don't sell your data. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

items.question: Do you share client information with third parties?
items.answer: Only with the tools we use to do the work (e.g. Google Ads, Meta, email platforms) — never for marketing or resale.

items.question: Is my account access secure?
items.answer: Yes. Sensitive credentials are stored in a password manager with restricted access, and we recommend keeping ownership of critical accounts under your own login with us added as a manager.

items.question: Are you hiring?
items.answer: Often, yes. Check the Careers page for current openings. Even if nothing there fits, we like meeting good people early — send us a note.

items.question: Do you take interns?
items.answer: Yes — we currently work with interns across marketing, SEO, and design.
